mapper.select: SELECT id, source_channel, source_record_id, app_version, province_code, city_code, district_code, fault_occurred_at, fault_time_precision, fault_time_source, fault_time_resolution, ingest_time, source_update_time, import_batch_id, data_environment FROM t_feedback_source WHERE id = #{sourceId}
mapper.sql:
data_environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND source_channel IN #{channel}
AND (province_code IN #{region} OR city_code IN #{region})
mapper.select: SELECT id, source_channel, province_code, city_code, fault_occurred_at FROM t_feedback_source WHERE AND ( (#{cursor.faultOccurredAt} IS NULL AND (fault_occurred_at IS NOT NULL OR (fault_occurred_at IS NULL AND id > #{cursor.id}))) OR (#{cursor.faultOccurredAt} IS NOT NULL AND fault_occurred_at IS NOT NULL AND (fault_occurred_at > #{cursor.faultOccurredAt} OR (fault_occurred_at = #{cursor.faultOccurredAt} AND id > #{cursor.id}))) ) ORDER BY fault_occurred_at IS NULL DESC, fault_occurred_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, source_channel, province_code, city_code, fault_occurred_at FROM t_feedback_source WHERE AND ( (#{cursor.faultOccurredAt} IS NULL AND fault_occurred_at IS NULL AND id < #{cursor.id}) OR (#{cursor.faultOccurredAt} IS NOT NULL AND (fault_occurred_at IS NULL OR fault_occurred_at < #{cursor.faultOccurredAt} OR (fault_occurred_at = #{cursor.faultOccurredAt} AND id < #{cursor.id}))) ) ORDER BY fault_occurred_at IS NULL, fault_occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
